FAQ

2. How long does my license last?

LightBurn will work forever as long as you have your license key, but after a year you will need to renew the maintenance on your license to keep getting the latest features and updates.

3. What does it mean to extend my license?

The license key has an expiry date for updates: one year from when you first activate it. When it expires, it's still valid, you just don't get updates anymore. - The license lets you use the software on up to two computers at once, they don't have to use the same operating system, and a license can be easily moved if you get a new computer.
